nl: A simple Vehicle with mass and max speed.
A Computer with CPU and Memory parts.
Battery has power output port. Motor has power input port. They connect via power interface.
Sensor provides data, Controller consumes data via interface.
Vehicle with mass. Car and Truck both inherit from Vehicle. Car has numDoors, Truck has payload.
Animal with name. Dog inherits Animal, has breed.
Car has 4 wheels and optionally 1 spare wheel.
Tree has many leaves, exactly 1 trunk.
Action to start engine, takes engine as input, returns status string. Has two steps: engage starter, check oil.
Login action: takes username and password, returns token.
Requirement: system shall respond within 100ms.
Car has 4 wheels, 1 engine, 1 chassis. Engine has power output port.
Brake system: master cylinder sends pressure to 4 wheel cylinders via hydraulic lines.
Aircraft has fuselage, 2 wings, 4 engines, and tail.
Flight control computer: receives pilot input, sends command to actuators.
Microservice UserAPI: GET /users, POST /users, returns User.
Database connection pool: max 100 connections, min 10.
Satellite system: bus + payload. Bus has power, communication, attitude control. Payload is scientific instrument.
Smart home: hub connects to lights, thermostat, security camera via WiFi.
A single integer attribute called x.
Empty part definition.
Part with abstract modifier.
A simple class with two fields (BAD: uses 'class' keyword).
A part def with extends (BAD: should use :>).
A part with port using slash syntax (BAD: should use connect).
Calculator with add, subtract, multiply, divide operations.
Electric vehicle: battery, motor, controller, with energy flow.
Transmission: 6-speed manual, gear ratios 3.5, 2.1, 1.4, 1.0, 0.8, 0.6.
Part with enumeration attribute.
Building with floors, rooms, HVAC system, electrical system.
